name: What types of materials are used for deck trim repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used for deck trim repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deck trim can be repaired using various materials, including natural wood such as cedar or redwood, pressure-treated lumber, or composite materials. The choice often depends on the existing deck material, aesthetic preference, and budget. Natural wood offers a classic look but requires more maintenance, while composite trim is highly durable and low-maintenance. We assess your current deck and discuss material options that best match your deck's existing structure and your desired outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include natural wood (cedar, redwood), pressure-treated lumber, or composite, chosen based on existing deck material, aesthetics, and budget.
